definitions: A religious belief among some Christians that financial blessing and physical well-being are always the will of God for them, and that faith, positive speech, and donations to religious causes will increase one's material wealth.
A controversial theological doctrine that links Christian faith with material wealth and physical health, often implying that God rewards belief with prosperity.
examples: Many televangelists preach the prosperity gospel.
Critics argue the prosperity gospel can exploit vulnerable people.
The prosperity gospel is a significant movement in some evangelical circles.
